stage: CGT-PAPER13 FINAL VERDICT (13-scene renderer paper-evidence lane)
one_line: The frozen CGT-F0 renderer's mixed-forward kernel speedup (geomean 1.26x on 50-tile samples) does NOT generalize to full-frame end-to-end rendering: per-frame per-tile fit+certify build costs ~40 min/frame geomean and the tile-based frame render is ~6.7x slower than canonical gsplat, so novel-view E2E speedup is ~0.

evidence_tiers.mixed_forward_tier: meaningful (1.20-1.50x) on 50-tile samples, BUT kernel-only (build excluded)

observed: 13/13 scenes have valid canonical checkpoints + data; F0 ingests all schemas (P0).
MIXED_FORWARD (P2): S_mixed geomean=1.2606, median=1.0216, min=0.97 (counter/truck), max=3.03 (room).
MIXED_FORWARD kernel correctness PASSES on all 13 scenes (max 1.85e-6 << 2e-5 gate) at R=4.
MIXED_FORWARD safe fraction mean=0.617, weighted fallback mean=0.451.
E2E (P3): full-frame build geomean=40.3 min/frame (0.9-301.7 min); CGT frame render 6.70x SLOWER than gsplat geomean.
E2E novel-view S=0.000 for all 13; N_break=None for 12 scenes (CGT render slower than canonical); counter N_break=30236.
F0 kernel is R=4-specific: R=8/R=16 fail kernel correctness (max_abs ~0.86).
inference: The CGT student+certificate compresses the per-tile render function and the fused kernel IS faster than the teacher kernel on small work-decile samples (mixed-forward).

But the representation is screen-space tile-based: it must be REBUILT (fit+certify) per camera per frame. For novel-view synthesis (a new camera every frame) this build is unavoidable and dominates (~40 min/frame).
The tile-based fused render (one block/tile, no cross-tile sort) is also ~6.7x slower than gsplat's optimized full-frame rasterizer, so even the render step loses to the strong canonical baseline.
Thus the kernel-level speedup does not survive the full production frame path.
hypothesis_not_measured: Whether a camera-independent CGT representation (amortized across views) could rescue E2E (would be a NEW method, forbidden in this frozen lane).
Full-image GT dPSNR/dSSIM/LPIPS quality gates (NOT_REACHED; mixed-forward tile-level only).
Nsight hardware counters (NOT_MEASURED; no profiler permission assumed).
not_measured: Same-hardware external renderer reproduction (section 29 optional) - NOT_ATTEMPTED.
consistency_with_upstream: Consistent with TI0 DROP_UPDATE_COST: representation refit/rebuild dominates.
Consistent with G5 DROP_NATIVE_OPTIMIZATION: CGT is not a training primitive.
Confirms CGT as a rendering representation with a real but non-generalizing kernel speedup.
decision: CLOSE the CGT-PAPER13 renderer generalization lane as DROP_RENDERER_GENERALIZATION. Do not promote to a larger multi-scene TI1. The frozen CGT renderer does not deliver a meaningful full-frame E2E acceleration against the strong canonical gsplat baseline.
